platform_constraint_evidence: CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs on ubuntu-latest. All build and test commands are cross-platform npm scripts. WebGL/WebGPU targets are web standards. Karma tests use Chrome which runs on Linux with xvfb. No Windows-only or macOS-only constraints detected.
build_system: Node.js project using npm as package manager. Build system uses rollup (rollup.config.mjs) with custom build.mjs wrapper. Commands: 'npm install' for dependencies, 'npm run build' for full build, 'npm run build:esm' for ES modules, 'npm run build:umd' for UMD bundle.
test_framework: Dual test setup: (1) Mocha + Chai for Node-based unit tests in /test directory using test/fixtures.mjs, run via 'npm test'. (2) Karma + Mocha + Sinon for browser-based tests in /tests directory using karma.conf.cjs, run via 'npm run test:karma' with xvfb for headless Chrome.
notes: Repository exploration complete. This is a cross-platform JavaScript/WebGL engine project. The fix/test path is fully runnable in a Linux x86-64 container. No platform incompatibility blocking synthesis.
